meta.notes: Preview is an installable host app (Windows/Linux/macOS), not a bootable OS. Target bare-metal track is seL4 (ADR 0001). Semantic IPC bus binds daemons at 127.0.0.1:24701.

nodes.label: aos-session
nodes.description: Preview session supervisor. Resolves AOS_HOME, writes configs, starts daemons in order, launches egui UI, watchdogs auditd/platformd/modeld, handles updates and clean shutdown.

nodes.label: aos-ui-egui
nodes.description: Primary Preview shell (egui). Chat, Agents, Models, Caps, Settings, DeclUI host for WASM modules (Create, Notes, Tasks, Canvas, Illustration Studio), transparency/activity panels.

nodes.label: aos-ui (TUI)
nodes.description: Minimal conversational TUI + resource dashboard (ratatui). Dev/debug surface alongside egui.

nodes.label: aos-mcpd
nodes.description: Optional stdio MCP façade so external IDEs can call akasha_models / akasha_infer / akasha_mem_* on a running Preview.

nodes.label: Public site
nodes.description: Static EN/FR marketing + end-user docs on GitHub Pages (azerothl.github.io/akasha-os). Not on the runtime bus.

nodes.label: aos-busd
nodes.description: Semantic IPC Bus broker (TCP localhost:24701). Typed intents with capability envelopes; CBOR framing. Central nervous system of Preview.

nodes.label: aos-ipc (lib)
nodes.description: Bus client, codec, broker, service registration helpers shared by all daemons and UIs.

nodes.label: aos-proto
nodes.description: Shared intent schemas, DeclUI contract, rich module UI types, request/response envelopes.

nodes.label: aos-capkd
nodes.description: Capability kernel (P4.2). Single trust application point: mint, derive, grant, revoke, check. Immediate global revoke across processes via the bus.

nodes.label: aos-caps (lib)
nodes.description: Logical capability model (rights bits, derive/attenuate). Used by capkd and platform fallbacks for WASM/agents.

nodes.label: aos-auditd
nodes.description: Autonomous append-only signed audit journal. Fire-and-forget; killing it does not stop Model or UI.

nodes.label: aos-modeld
nodes.description: Model subsystem daemon. Local GGUF inference (llama.cpp), media.image/video/TTS packs (sd.cpp / piper), providers (OpenAI-compat + loopback), placement, LAN cluster coordinator, live metrics.

nodes.label: aos-llama
nodes.description: llama.cpp bindings (CUDA / Metal / CPU). Chat, vision (mtmd), embeddings, prefix cache, speculative decode.

nodes.label: aos-sd
nodes.description: Stable Diffusion / LTX media engine wrapper used by modeld for image and short video generation.

nodes.label: aos-placement
nodes.description: Hardware-aware model weight placement across RAM / GPU / disk; CPU/GPU hysteresis for unified artefacts.

nodes.label: aos-registry
nodes.description: YAML model catalogue and backend descriptors (local packs + provider offerings).

nodes.label: aos-platformd
nodes.description: Platform daemon: semantic FS, Memory V2, chat sessions, WASM module runtime (wasmtime), DeclUI, confirmations, devices, health plane, vault, network egress, feedback, catalogue.

nodes.label: WASM Module Runtime
nodes.description: Sandboxed wasmtime host. Modules call host_call only (no ambient WASI). Caps gate every tool; DeclUI frames rendered by egui host.

nodes.label: aos-scene
nodes.description: SceneGraph edit / locks / apply for Canvas and Illustration Studio. Viewport stays in egui; no wgpu in this crate.

nodes.label: aos-agentd
nodes.description: Agent runtime daemon. Goal loop, skills, tools, MCP client, harness.run (external CLIs), scheduler, salon turns, deep-thinking, trace export. Spawns isolated aos-agent-worker processes.

nodes.label: aos-agent-worker
nodes.description: Isolated per-agent worker process. Executes tool calls under granted caps; communicates with agentd over the bus.

nodes.label: Skills
nodes.description: MIT-licensed skill packs (deep-thinking, planner, research, notes-writer, file-author, tasks). User skills under var/skills/. Shared frontmatter per ADR 0008.

nodes.label: Create
nodes.description: Rich DeclUI image/video workspace. UI state under /documents/create/**; generation via platform media.image.generate service.

nodes.label: Notes
nodes.description: Human + agent notes with tags, live search, delete. Dual-surface WASM package.

nodes.label: Tasks
nodes.description: Dual-surface tasks module + Tasks tab. DeclUI package synced on boot.

nodes.label: Canvas
nodes.description: Layered vector drawing: grid/snap, scenes, guides, PNG/SVG/JSON export, agent geometry validation.

nodes.label: Illustration Studio
nodes.description: Experimental DeclUI scene editor. wgpu edit viewport ≠ beauty; stub/CPU beauty; optional GPL Blender Renderer Pack.

nodes.label: ext-rt
nodes.description: Precompiled script-module WASM runtime used by scaffolded guest packages without a full Rust SDK build.

nodes.label: Module SDK
nodes.description: Apache-2.0 guest SDK. Rust modules compile against host_call only — no ambient WASI. Separate workspace from host crates.

nodes.label: aos-bridge
nodes.description: Sibling HTTP↔bus contract helpers and schema export (E8). Documents live under docs/bridge/.

nodes.label: var/ (runtime state)
nodes.description: Mutable Preview home state: sessions, memory, agents, audit, skills, feedback, run pids/logs, LAN pairing.

nodes.label: share/ (read-mostly)
nodes.description: Shipped models catalogue, signed module catalogue, MCP examples, preview profile.

nodes.label: Host OS
nodes.description: Windows 10/11 x64, Linux x64, or macOS Apple Silicon. Preview scaffold per ADR 0001 — not the final bare-metal product.

nodes.label: GPU / CPU
nodes.description: NVIDIA CUDA (Win/Linux) or Metal (macOS) preferred; unified zip also ships aos-modeld-cpu path.

nodes.label: Cloud / loopback providers
nodes.description: OpenAI-compatible cloud APIs plus local loopback (Ollama / vLLM / LM Studio). API keys in the OS keyring vault.

nodes.label: Network egress
nodes.description: Deny-by-default. Opt-in web.search, web.browse (no JS), web.fetch. JS/SPA via optional browser MCP.

nodes.label: External coding CLIs
nodes.description: Opt-in harness.run / Agents Advanced Runtime for Codex, Claude, Grok with Steer / Pause / Kill.

nodes.label: seL4 bare-metal track
nodes.description: Future product form: machine boots seL4 + Agent OS without Windows/Linux. VM scaffold exists; GPU AccelDevice later (P5.3).

flows.name: Preview boot
flows.summary: aos-session brings up the bus and daemons, healthchecks, then launches the egui shell.

flows.name: Chat → local inference
flows.summary: User message in egui becomes an infer intent on the bus; modeld runs llama.cpp on GPU/CPU and streams tokens back.

flows.name: Chat → cloud/loopback provider
flows.summary: When routing selects a provider, modeld forwards the completion to OpenAI-compat or Ollama/vLLM/LM Studio.

flows.name: Agent goal loop
flows.summary: agentd plans with skills, spawns a worker, calls tools via bus under caps, audits actions, may infer via modeld.

flows.name: Create image generation
flows.summary: Create DeclUI module requests media.image.generate; modeld drives sd.cpp and writes under /downloads/images.

flows.name: Notes module host_call
flows.summary: Notes WASM package issues host_call; platform runtime enforces caps and persists via semantic FS.

flows.name: Canvas scene edit
flows.summary: Canvas module edits SceneGraph through platform/aos-scene; agents can validate geometry over the bus.

flows.name: Illustration Studio edit
flows.summary: Experimental studio DeclUI edits scene graph; beauty path is stub/CPU or optional Blender pack — distinct from wgpu edit viewport.

flows.name: Capability revoke
flows.summary: User revokes a cap in UI; capkd applies globally; subsequent platform/agent checks fail closed.

flows.name: Memory remember / recall
flows.summary: Chat or agent writes Memory V2 (decision journal / mind palace); recall feeds later agent bootstrap. Shadow projection keeps legacy facts in sync.

flows.name: IDE via aos-mcpd
flows.summary: External IDE speaks MCP stdio to aos-mcpd, which translates to bus infer/mem intents on a running Preview.

flows.name: Opt-in web search
flows.summary: With network enabled, platformd performs web.search/browse/fetch under egress policy and may audit the access.

flows.name: External coding CLI harness
flows.summary: Agents Advanced Runtime starts Codex/Claude/Grok via harness.run with Steer/Pause/Kill controls.

flows.name: Model load & placement
flows.summary: User selects a pack; modeld consults registry + placement, loads GGUF onto GPU/CPU, exposes metrics (TTFT, tok/s, VRAM).

flows.name: Device capture
flows.summary: Camera/mic intents require confirmation (Allow once / Always / Deny); artefacts land under var/sessions/<id>/devices/.

flows.name: Non-destructive update
flows.summary: aos-session checks GitHub Releases, stages archive, applies overlay on next restart without wiping user var/.
